validation_scope: Retrospective raster-derived conditional current screening; reserved density is a measured input, not a forecast; no independent-specimen or prospective validation

negatives.finding: Public deposit contains one11pagePDF only, no native traces or tables. Main fullbody returned403; author bibliography supplies no manuscript.
FigureS8 is540x412JPEG with no vector paths. Cycles1/2,3/4,6/7 have unresolved current curves and share broad intervals/midpoints. Seven rows are not seven resolved current measurements.
S8 scan rate, precise integration limits and background uncertainty remain unspecified. Published Fe density is a derived proxy; no independent charge reintegration is claimed.
TOF contains the same charge denominator used for density. No current was reconstructed from density times TOF, and TOF was not used as an independent response.
Changing-competence M1 and both constant-current baselines fail the reserved midpoint screen. Both M0 and M1 exceed the10percent normalized-error criterion in early-cycle calibration.
M0 passes the nominal reserved screen, but M0 and M1 both pass and fail at different extraction-box corners. This is not robust mechanistic selection or repair validation.

All16384independent box corners were checked, but this is not a continuous bound, probability or confidence interval; source correlations are unmodeled. B4 has a hypothetical passing interior despite zero passing corners.

An identical-initial-pool, conserved-inventory counterexample admits founder exposure and fresh-material addition with the same total Fe-redox count and current. Actual founder inventory/function ceilings are absent.
Changing Ni activity, double-layer subtraction, accessibility, morphology and restructuring during the diagnostic sweep remain alternatives to changing intrinsic Fe competence.
No matched gas/Faradaic-efficiency or origin-specific product assay, damaged-founder replacement control, serial functional descendants or target integration is supplied for these cycles.
Vulcan carbon black, Nafion and glassy carbon are functional electrode components. This source is not a demonstrated noncarbon complement, nor a transferable rate for bare-Ni/Han/Poli/PMo12/Mo34WV.
The SI points toS6 for the pure-Ni background actually shown inS5. This is retained as a figure-reference error, not an invented electrode-voltage correction.
